GOVERNMENT_SPBE.label: Pemerintah / Kementerian / Lembaga / Pemda (SPBE)

primary_methodologies.presales: LKPP tender intelligence, Provider RAB/BoQ (strictly distinct from PPK HPS), PDN/TKDN + >=40% UMKK compliance
primary_methodologies.grc: 6-Domain SPBE readiness + Indeks KAMI BSSN + UU PDP Pasal 4/20/34/46/56 + ISO 27001 Clauses 4-10
primary_methodologies.ea: TOGAF 10 ADM explicitly mapped to 6 SPBE Architecture Domains + Satu Data Indonesia interoperability
primary_methodologies.pmo: KAK/Kontrak/Addendum hierarchy + PPK/KPA change sign-off + Laporan Pendahuluan/Antara/Akhir
primary_methodologies.modernize: Public-service continuity, data migration reconciliation, and phased Strangler Fig transition

prohibited_claims: Setting or approving official HPS on behalf of PPK
Issuing official SPBE maturity certification or Indeks KAMI official rating

BANKING.label: Perbankan Umum (OJK Regulated)

primary_methodologies.presales: Core/channel capacity sizing with DR/RPO/RTO HA topologies + 5-year TCO + vendor/PPJTI compliance costs
primary_methodologies.grc: POJK 11/2022 + PADK OJK 1/2026 (effective 2026-03-01, replacing SEOJK 21/2017) + ISO 27001 + COBIT 2019 Design vs Operating control testing
primary_methodologies.ea: TOGAF 10 ADM + RSTI alignment + PPJTI/DC/DRC boundary architecture
primary_methodologies.pmo: Bank IT Steering Committee (Komite Pengarah TI) + Change Control Board + OJK reporting lead times
primary_methodologies.modernize: Core/channel business-rule archaeology, financial ledger reconciliation invariants, zero-downtime parallel run

prohibited_claims: Citing revoked SEOJK 21/SEOJK.03/2017 as active banking rule after 2026-03-01
Claiming ISO 27001 certification or OJK regulatory approval from advisory review

FINTECH.label: Fintech / Payment / P2P Lending (BI / OJK Regulated)

primary_methodologies.presales: High-burst concurrency & idempotent ledger sizing + FinOps unit economics
primary_methodologies.grc: UU PDP Pasal 4(2) personal financial/biometric controls + ISO 27001 + PCI/SNAP BI security alignment (verify license-specific BI/OJK rules per entity)
primary_methodologies.ea: API-first domain boundaries, payment ledger isolation, observability & disaster failover
primary_methodologies.pmo: Strict security/UAT sign-off gates before production cutover
primary_methodologies.modernize: Double-entry ledger reconciliation & payment callback idempotency preservation

prohibited_claims: Asserting BI PJP or OJK fintech licensing compliance without verifying entity-specific license category

BUMN.label: Badan Usaha Milik Negara (BUMN)

primary_methodologies.presales: TCO/NPV/ROI business case + internal BUMN procurement + PDN/TKDN alignment
primary_methodologies.grc: COBIT 2019 governance + ISO 27001:2022 ISMS + BUMN internal IT governance & GCG alignment
primary_methodologies.ea: Multi-subsidiary application rationalization (TIME) & shared master data
primary_methodologies.pmo: Program/portfolio governance, EVM tracking, formal CR & BAST governance
primary_methodologies.modernize: Multi-year ERP/legacy consolidation economics & coexistence cost modeling

prohibited_claims: Substituting internal BUMN procurement guidelines without verifying client corporate bylaws

GENERAL_ENTERPRISE.label: Korporasi Swasta / Enterprise Umum

primary_methodologies.presales: Solution Options MCDA, 3-scenario capacity sizing, 3-5 yr TCO/NPV/Payback, commercial margin modeling
primary_methodologies.grc: Risk-based control testing (Design vs Operating), ISO 27001:2022 Clauses 4-10 + SoA, COBIT 2019, UU PDP
primary_methodologies.ea: Business Capability Mapping, TIME Portfolio Management, ABB/SBB Gap Analysis
primary_methodologies.pmo: SOW/Contract hierarchy, PERT/CPM + Monte Carlo schedule risk, Earned Value & CCB governance
primary_methodologies.modernize: 8-area technical due diligence, business-rule archaeology, refactor vs rewrite TCO

prohibited_claims: Issuing binding legal determinations on Paid CR liability without contract/legal review
Claiming official ISO 27001 certification from internal advisory assessment
